name: The Opal communications database: Teams transcripts, market updates, and investment feedback, with a draft commentary service
description: One private database (bucket opal-data-transcripts) for Opal's investment communications, kept as received in bronze and typed, de-duplicated and PII-wiped in silver, so analytics and a draft-commentary service can be built on it. Transcripts of the four regular meetings arrive on their own (Teams via the Opal gateway); market updates (PowerPoint) are kept exactly as received; investment feedback that Manav sends a client with a YCharts report attached is pulled daily from Andrew's mailbox through the gateway. A commentary Lambda, triggered when an Analysis report is READY, slices gold examples in Python and makes one Kimi K3 call to draft commentary that lands as an Opal-internal Ticket Center ticket. Two named readers of the raw tier. More outcomes will follow this start (Andrew 2026-09-30).
